title: Window Scene
global_prompt: The same clearly adult character, age 28, in the same room, realistic cinematic style, warm evening light, stable identity and clothing, continuous natural motion
negative_prompt: underage, childlike appearance, identity drift, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, fused fingers, flicker, jitter, sudden scene cut, low quality

shots.name: Approach Window
shots.prompt: The character slowly walks toward the window, clothes and hair move naturally

shots.name: Turn To Camera
shots.prompt: The character turns toward the camera and establishes eye contact, subtle natural breathing
